# Go test/benchmark/fuzz functions deliberately removed from the tree, one per
# line, as "<FuncName>  # <file> :: <grep target> :: <bucket>".
#
# The inventory gate subtracts the number of entries here from the expected
# total. Adding an entry is how a deliberate deletion is itemized; a removal
# that is not listed here fails the gate as an unexplained loss.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
